node.title: Re: Storing String from Line Before Regex Match
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [Nico],

I like [toolic]'s [id://1159217|approach] better, but in the spirit of TIMTOWTDI:

my $re = qr/ First\ Name: \s+ (.+)\n Last\ Name: \s+ (.+)\n (?:.+\n)* Location:\ Central\ USA\n /x; while ($line=~/$re/g) { print "<$1> <$2>\n"; }

Note the use of the [doc://perlre#/x|/x modifier] to make the regex more readable. Also, I removed the /s modifier, so that the dot . doesn't match newlines.

I think this approach is probably a little less robust than splitting the input file on empty lines, but if you're sure of the formatting of the input files this should still work.

Hope that helps,
-- Hauke D
